Yemen's Houthi Rebels Announce Naval Blockade on Saudi Arabia

The Houthi rebels, backed by Iran, have announced a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia at the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which is a critical gateway to the Red Sea. The move has raised concerns about disruptions to global oil supplies and regional security. The conflict between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis has escalated since last week's attack on Sana'a airport.
